How these estimates work

Vehicle counts: YOLO detects vehicles and the tracker counts each ID once. Tracking errors can cause repeat counts. A dash means detections are present but the tracker has not confirmed IDs yet; those detections still contribute to traffic density. The current model counts two-wheelers, auto-rickshaws, cars, and buses/trucks. Buses and trucks share one category.

Traffic density: a simple visible-vehicle load estimate, averaged over the last 10 seconds of video: 0 = no traffic, up to 5 = low, over 5 to 15 = moderate, over 15 = high. This is not vehicles per kilometre or road occupancy.

Suggested green time: 3 seconds per average visible vehicle, rounded up and limited to 10–60 seconds; 0 when no vehicles are detected in the window. This is a demonstration estimate, not a validated signal timing plan. It does not measure stopped queues or control traffic signals.
